tagline: Silverdale's outdoor power equipment experts for fifty years
heroSubheading: We've served Silverdale for half a century with the tools and know-how you need.
aboutHtml:
We're Peter and Judy Leishman, and we've been part of the Silverdale community for twenty years. For the last decade, we've been running STIHL SHOP Silverdale, carrying on half a century of locally owned outdoor power equipment retail in Silverdale. Our know-how comes from real experience, and we put it to work helping locals find the right tools for their jobs.

We stock a full range of outdoor power equipment from the brands you trust, including STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, Hansa, Lawnmaster, Ferris, Hustler, Victa, Silky, Wolf Garten and Solo. You can browse and buy in store, or shop online for home delivery or click and collect. When your equipment needs servicing or repair, our fully trained technicians and spare parts stocks mean we can look after it properly.

We're active in the community—Pete's a Rotarian, Judy sits on the Silverdale Business Association board—and we sponsor local groups because we care about Silverdale. Come in and see why locals have trusted us for half a century.
